body:
Leonard,

Done. The send list is "Q4 update - send list" in my Q4 2025 investor update folder, shared with you. It covers the bridge round only, as of end of day Tue Sep 30 PT, using the rules in your send list doc. Here's how many are in each group:

- New investors: 0 firms, 1 angel (Anton Bernstein, $40K. His DocuSign Completed notice came in Sep 26)
- In talks: 8 firms, 1 angel (T-Accelerate, Dentsu Ventures, NCsoft, SciPlay, a16z, GFR Fund, Homa, Brightwater Games Fund; Paul Heydon at $50K)
- Awaiting reply: 14 firms, 0 angels
- Keep warm: 2 firms, 0 angels (LVP, Hiro Capital)

That's 26 rows in total. Everyone else stays off the list.

A few things to look at on Monday:
- Paul is in "In talks" and not "New investors". His SAFE was still unsigned in DocuSign on the 29th and no Completed notice has come in.
- Build access: only T-Accelerate and Dentsu have the internal build, and it's iOS only for both. Arthur found on the 30th that the Play investor tester list was never attached to the internal track, even though ZOM-567 shows them as added. If that's fixed before the send, those two can switch to iOS and Android. None of the other firms in talks have tester access.
- Homa and Brightwater aren't on the 2025 list. I included them because we had calls with them about the bridge and both were on my calendar.
- The a16z speedrun rejection doesn't count as their answer on the bridge, so they're still in talks. The e2vc calls were never on my calendar, so they're in Awaiting reply. Play Ventures passed through Griffin without a call, so they stay off.
- Judgment calls in Awaiting reply: General Catalyst (the Latest Status says "reached out" but the email bounced, and I counted it as written) and Treo VC (you sent them the deck on LinkedIn on Sep 3 after they came to us).

I also added a Keep warm checklist to the Existing Investor Update card with LVP and Hiro Capital on it.

Talk Monday,
Fred
